meta.description: Draws and exports phylogenetic trees while making layout, support, rooting, and scale claims explicit.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: The Skill explicitly distinguishes topology, distance, time, support measures, and uncertainty rather than inventing biological conclusions.

practice_boundaries.detail: It generates research figures only and does not diagnose, prescribe, or triage an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: Rooting, MRCA validation, named support, HPD preservation, scale bars, and layout limits were exercised in fresh runs.

code_usability.detail: All seven sampled Python/R paths completed in the isolated private runtime and produced asserted artifacts.

functional_suitability.note: Quick Python, rich R, ape fallback, GUI/web routing, support, rooting, large-tree, and export cases are covered.

reliability.note: Explicit failure modes and guards are strong; web and desktop alternatives cannot be reproducibly executed in this audit.

performance_context.note: The compact main file routes detailed code to references and gives concrete tip-count limits.

agent_usability.note: Decision rule, routes, thresholds, and actionable failure messages are clear.

human_usability.note: Natural prompts and usage guide are concise; necessary phylogenetic terminology is advanced.

security.note: No credentials, raw-code execution, destructive commands, or sensitive-data handling are present.

maintainability.note: Recipe separation and version notes are strong; several rendering engines have unavoidable upstream-version variability.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggering, escape routes, and reference index support cold-start agent use.

key_strengths: The Skill makes layout, support, root, and scale choices explicit rather than treating a tree as neutral decoration.
Python safeguards and isolated-R composite/fallback paths produced concrete asserted vector artifacts.
Reference splitting keeps the main instruction set compact while preserving runnable recipes.
